department: Department of Computer and Information Science and Engineering

deadline.value: December 5 deadline for Fall PhD applicants
deadline.quote: Ph.D. applicants must apply to the Fall semesters. We do not accept new Ph.D. students in the Spring semesters. | Fall | December 5

gre_general.value: Scores from the general Graduate Record Examination (GRE) are optional.
gre_general.quote: GRE: Scores from the general Graduate Record Examination (GRE) are optional.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Computer Science subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Pre-application contact with faculty is not stated as required.

funding.value: Department offers Graduate School Fellowships and Teaching Assistantships of approx $32,000 stipend plus tuition waiver.
funding.quote: The department offers a number of Graduate School Fellowship Awards each year to new Ph.D. students. This 5-year fellowship offers an approximately $32,000 annual stipend, plus tuition waiver and other benefits.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from bachelor's degree with upper-division GPA of at least 3.0.
entry_route.quote: For applicants with solely a bachelor’s degree, a minimum 3.0 GPA on all coursework completed after the applicant has earned 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) is required.

toefl_min.value: Department requires minimum 90 iBT with at least 19 in each section.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: minimum score of 90 iBT, with each section scoring at least 19.

ielts_min.value: Department requires minimum IELTS overall score of 7.5.
ielts_min.quote: Alternatively, IELTS with an overall score of at least 7.5 (Reading 6.5, Listening 6.5, Speaking 6.5, Writing 5.5 minimum per section).

english_waiver.value: Indian applicants are required to submit TOEFL or IELTS scores.
english_waiver.quote: Please note that Indian students are now REQUIRED to submit a TOEFL or IELTS score.
